_comment: Business-line template: Mustard Oil (expeller) unit (IIFPT PM-FME model DPR). Contingency (Rs 0.62 L) folded into misc fixed assets. NOTE: the sale price used with this template is an EFFECTIVE price per litre of oil that includes oil-cake by-product realization (~Rs 40/L on top of ~Rs 92/L oil), since the engine models a single product stream. Wastage 65.63% = non-oil fraction of seed (oil yield ~34%).
report_title: DETAILED PROJECT REPORT - MUSTARD OIL UNIT

machinery_items_indicative.name: Heavy duty Oil Expeller, chamber 30" x 5.5", up to 250 kg/hr, with oil collection tank
Filter press 18" x 18" - 18 taps with filter cloth, oil collection tray, oil pump & accessories
Essential spare parts (worm set, cage set, filter cloth)
Crompton electric motor 3-phase 20 HP with L&T starter
Accessories: pulley, v-belts, pipelines, fittings, valves

narrative.product_intro: Mustard oil is produced by pressing mustard seeds to yield a pungent, distinctively flavoured edible oil widely used in Indian cooking; the pressing also yields mustard oil cake, a valuable by-product sold as cattle-feed ingredient, whose realization is included in the unit's effective price per litre.
narrative.raw_material_note: Raw material is mustard seed (mainly black mustard) plus packing material (bottles); seed is a winter oilseed widely traded in mandis, with Rajasthan, MP, Haryana and UP the main producing states.
process_steps: Seed drying (sun drying to reduce moisture)
Cleaning (removal of dirt and foreign particles)
Seed heating (improves oil yield and cake protein)
Oil extraction in expeller press (approx. 26-30% oil recovery)
Filling, sealing and packaging in bottles
By-product: oil cake collected and sold as cattle-feed ingredient
